messages.subject: Implemented multi_normal_prec
parts:
I've implemented multi_normal_prec, which parameterizes the multivariate normal in terms of a precision matrix.  I've also reimplemented multi_normal to take full advantage of the new work on mdivide_left and log_determinant.

I've pushed it, but I haven't had time to add any docs for the new multi_normal_prec distributions.

Cheers,
Marcus
